meta.name: turtle_shell_village
meta.prompt: A fishing village built on the shell of a colossal sleeping sea turtle beached in a bay: houses on the ridges of its shell, ladders down its flippers to the boats, its head resting on the sand.

programs.brief: The colossal ancient head of a sleeping sea turtle resting peacefully on the sandy shore of the bay, eyes closed in slumber, weathered jade-green scutes and barnacle clusters along the neck.
A colossal sea turtle flipper extending into the bay shallows, with wooden catwalks, rope ladders, winches, and mooring cleats leading down from the shell edge to the water.
Driftwood fish drying racks with hanging nets, cured fish lines, salt crates, and rope ladders slung between the ridges of the carapace.

tokens.terrain: a sheltered ocean bay with a sandy beach and open water; a colossal sleeping sea turtle beached at the tide line with its massive head resting on the sand and flippers reaching into the shallows
tokens.icons: village cottages and shacks clinging to the scutes and ridges of the colossal turtle shell; wooden catwalks and rope ladders hung from the shell flanks and flippers down to moored fishing boats; drying nets and fish racks slung between carapace ridges
tokens.landmark: the colossal sleeping sea turtle itself, forming the living island and foundation of the village

root.label: the sleeping colossus in the bay
